title: SSH Protocol Version 2
description: Ensure SSH version 2 is used. Version 1 has known cryptographic vulnerabilities.

title: Telnet Disabled
description: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext. It must be disabled on all VTY lines.
remediation: Configure: line vty 0 4 / transport input ssh

title: VTY Lines Restricted to SSH
description: VTY lines should only accept SSH connections to prevent cleartext remote access.
remediation: Configure: line vty 0 4 / transport input ssh

title: VTY ACL Applied
description: An access control list should restrict which IP addresses can access the device via VTY.

title: VTY Exec Timeout
description: VTY sessions must time out after no more than 10 minutes of inactivity.

title: SNMPv3 Only
description: SNMPv1 and v2c use cleartext community strings. Only SNMPv3 with auth+priv is acceptable.
remediation: Configure SNMPv3 user with auth SHA and priv AES-128

title: No SNMP Public Community
description: The default 'public' SNMP community string must not be configured (read access to all MIBs).

title: No SNMP Private Community
description: The default 'private' SNMP community string must not be configured (write access).

title: AAA Enabled
description: Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting must be centrally managed.

title: AAA New-Model
description: The 'aaa new-model' command must be present to enable the AAA framework.

title: NTP Configured
description: Network Time Protocol must be configured to ensure accurate timestamps for logs.

title: NTP Authentication
description: NTP must use authentication to prevent rogue NTP servers from manipulating device time.
remediation: Configure: ntp authenticate / ntp authentication-key <id> md5 <key> / ntp trusted-key <id>

title: Password Encryption Service
description: The 'service password-encryption' command must be enabled to obfuscate type-7 passwords.

title: Enable Secret Configured
description: The enable secret (type-5 or better) must be set to prevent unauthorized privileged access.

title: HTTP Server Disabled
description: The HTTP server exposes device management over cleartext. It must be disabled.

title: MOTD Banner Configured
description: A login banner (MOTD) must be configured with a legal warning notice.
remediation: Configure: banner motd # Authorized access only. Unauthorized access is prohibited. #

title: Logging Enabled
description: Logging must be enabled and sent to a remote syslog server for audit trail.

title: Remote Syslog Host Configured
description: Logs must be forwarded to a remote syslog server to ensure they cannot be tampered with locally.

title: CDP Disabled Globally
description: Cisco Discovery Protocol reveals network topology to adjacent devices. Disable if not required.
